title: Quiet hours — operational scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
Quick, messy notes for quiet-hours shift (late-night / low traffic). Keep short — this is a scratchpad that I update in-flight.

Shift summary (top-line):
- No active P0s. One P2 (search latency spikes) flapping in prod-us-west; currently mitigated via routing to alt-pool. See INC-2026 for timeline.
- Scheduled batch jobs (indexing-job-overnight) started at 01:10 UTC, ran through expected windows. Post-run memory growth noted on serving-x32 (see notes below).
- Alert noise reduced after temporary rule change for tokenization-faults (silenced until 08:00 PT).

What I did in this shift (short log):
- 00:45 — Rotated forwarding rule to route low-priority traffic to dedupe-pool to reduce tail latency.
- 01:15 — Noticed OOM trend on serving-x32; forced a restart of process group and cleared cache (kvcache flush).
- 02:00 — Increased autoscaler min for alt-pool from 2 -> 3 to stabilize throughput.
- 03:30 — Tuned batching timeout for model gpt-small-qa (reduced from 20ms -> 12ms) to cut lat tails for interactive routes.

Current systems to watch (stateful):
- serving-x32 (node id: sx32-prod-usw). Restarted once; memory resets but trend returns after heavy index writes. Suspect leak in plugin: index-serializer v0.9.
- kv-cache-cluster-2: replication lag ~120ms (usually <50ms). Happening after nightly index.
- routing-proxy-a: 0.1% 5xx increase in last hour — correlated with cache warm-up.

Immediate temporary procedures (for on-call):
- If serving-x32 memory climbs >85% for >10m: 1) Move incoming traffic off node via maintenance label, 2) Kill worker group gracefully, 3) Re-enable after memory stable for 5m.
- If kv-cache replication >300ms: 1) Scale replica count +1 for cluster-2, 2) Pause any writes from indexing job via feature-flag (indexing.pause=true), 3) Open ticket INF-759 and add logs.
- If routing-proxy 5xx rate >0.5% for 15m: 1) Switch proxy routing to blue-backup (manual toggle in console), 2) Fallback to model variant gpt-small-qa-v2 for latency-sensitive routes.

Quick runbook snippets (commands / console flows):
- Drain node (k8s): kubectl cordon serving-x32 && kubectl drain serving-x32 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
- Flush KV cache (internal): /opt/redwood/bin/kvcachectl --cluster cluster-2 --flush-prefix "indexing/2026-03-10"
- Toggle feature flag (console API): curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' https://console.internal/api/flags -d '{"key":"indexing.pause","value":true}'
- Scale replica: terraform apply -var='replica_count=3' -target=module.kv_cache_cluster_2

Observed weirdness / hypotheses (notes to self):
- Memory bump on serving-x32 happens ~5-10 minutes after indexing job bulk commits — possibly due to large serialized blobs being cached in memory instead of going to disk. Hypothesis: index-serializer v0.9 retains references during async flush.
- KV replication lag seems to match peak write contention windows; maybe missed a backpressure signal in shard router. Need to add instrumentation for write queue depth.

Open follow-ups (not blocking, but document):
- Create a short repro for index-serializer memory retention on staging (assign to Riley). TODO: add GH link.
- Add metric for write queue depth in kv-cache router (owner: Owen).
- Revisit batching default config for gpt-small-qa (longer-term; potential perf win).

Hand-over checklist for next shift:
- Confirm serving-x32 stable for 30m after restart. If not, escalate to SRE lead (page: Owen).
- Ensure indexing job completes and replication lag returns <80ms.
- Leave this doc flagged in Slack with summary: "quiet-hours: one P2 (search latency) — mitigated; track serving-x32".

Notes to self (shortcuts + bookmarks):
- Perf dashboard: https://dash.internal/boards/latency-overview?range=6h
- Inc timeline (INC-2026): https://incidents.internal/INC-2026
- Quick run commands: https://wiki.internal/oncall/quick-commands

Unresolved / low priority ideas:
- Explore per-index write batching to smooth memory use.
- Consider lazy-serialization flag for index-serializer plugin.

Personal scribbles (ignore if noisy):
- If sleepy: drink water, do 5-min walk, avoid touching infra unless clear noise.
- Reminder: PM for search feature meeting Wednesday 10am PT — bring perf graphs.

End-of-shift short log (template to paste in Slack):
- Quiet-hours update: No P0s. P2 (search latency) mitigated via routing and autoscaler bump. Restarted serving-x32 for memory reset; monitoring. Indexing-run completed. Leaving follow-ups in ticket INF-759 and this doc.
